cells.gaps: All three rows (MDG-001 to MDG-003) are dated 7 October 2026, after the as-at of 30 September 2026, so none sets anything. They describe one commune, Antananarivo, launching a market register that day; nothing is held on any commune at the as-at.
cells.note: The country has rows and none is dated by the as-at, so no rung can be set. Had the launch fallen inside, a single commune launching would have read as stage 2 at most.
